locations.label: Ship power switch
locations.description: From the beach, buy the route onto the broken ship and climb to its upper control room. Flip the wall switch to power the map. Open a route between the ship, lighthouse and Stamin-Up so you can reach generators and return to the quest door without dead ends. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Crew’s locked door
locations.description: With power on, go below the PhD Flopper room in the lighthouse annex. Knife the large metal door and listen to the trapped crew. Wait until they ask for a fuse before searching upstairs. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Wheel and levers
locations.description: Return to the power room. From their untouched starting positions, turn the ship’s wheel twice clockwise so its differently coloured handle points down-right, around five o’clock. Pull the left lever once, leave the middle lever alone, and pull the right lever three times. Compare the completed wheel and levers in the photos. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Four lighthouse floor dials
locations.description: The target from top to bottom is Yellow 2, Orange 7, Blue 4, Purple 6. Turning a dial adds one to itself and the immediately adjacent floor dial(s), wrapping 9 back to 0. Setting each floor independently will disturb the others. Read all four current digits and enter them in the solver below; apply its turn counts without additional adjustments. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
